metadata.title: ApexSQL_DevOps_toolkit
metadata.description: The ApexSQL DevOps toolkit is a set of components and scripts that integrate with ApexSQL SQL developer tools to create SQL Server database continuous integration and delivery automation pipelines. The PowerShell functions provide SQL Server DevOps capability to any Windows environment.
